description:
Experience Ultra-Quiet, Belt-Driven Performance
Glide through the city with the HITWAY BK19 Pro's revolutionary silent rear hub motor and maintenance-free belt drive system. This ultra-quiet combination delivers an incredibly smooth ride without the noise and mess of traditional chains. Choose from 5 levels of pedal assist (PAS) to perfectly match your effort and conquer any incline effortlessly.
Sleek Integrated Battery Design & Extended Range

Power your commute with the seamlessly integrated and removable 36V 10.4AH (374.4WH) battery. This flush design ensures a harmonious and elegant frame aesthetic while providing an impressive travel range of 40–80km per charge. Easily remove the battery for convenient and secure indoor charging.?
Smart Control & Connectivity with the HITWAY APP
Transform your riding experience with the dedicated HITWAY Smartphone APP. Connect instantly to unlock smart features like digital e-bike lock/unlock, real-time ride statistics tracking (mileage, speed), and quick fault detection. Keep your bike secure and your data on hand for a truly modern and connected ride.
Reliable Hydraulic Disc Brakes & All-Weather Safety
Safety is paramount. The BK19 Pro features upgraded front and rear hydraulic disc brakes, providing reliable and powerful stopping power in all conditions. Built on a robust, rust-resistant, high-strength step-over aluminum alloy frame, the bike remains exceptionally maneuverable and lightweight at just 20kg.
Comfort-Focused Commuter Design & StVZO Lighting
Designed for the discerning urban commuter, this e-bike ensures maximum comfort and practicality. It is equipped with 700*42c road-bike tires for excellent traction, an adjustable handlebar angle for a customized fit, and essential safety features like StVZO-certified front and rear lights and sturdy fenders—everything you need for a comfortable and compliant journey across Europe.
